scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && npm run db:generate && node scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @soundboard/api" "npm run dev -w @soundboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @soundboard/db && npm run build -w @soundboard/shared && npm run build -w @soundboard/api && npm run build -w @soundboard/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @soundboard/web --if-present && npm run lint -w @soundboard/api --if-present
